summary: the reference circuit of the fuzzy_ub encoding (UB) expressed through the Builder; every angle is a linear function of spec.alpha / spec.beta.
the reference circuit after the deterministic polish passes.

parity frame + f-controlled qubit-permutation frames (8 Fredkins total, DP-optimal over sector order) + Bell decode + per-sector Gray-code C^3-R_x phase polynomials on a persistent sector one-hot; 200 CX.

parity frame, then 8 per-sector sandwiches F_p^dag C^{p,S}R_x(-4 beta sigma_p) F_p with uncontrolled frames (f-controlled q2 permutation + Bell decoders), merged permutations between sectors and Gray-shared rccx ladders.

per-sector f-controlled Fredkin routing of q2 spins so each parity sector is X_f (x) (vertex-singlet projector); Bell-decode the singlet pairs into flags and apply one multi-controlled R_x(-4 beta sigma) on f per sector.

parent r01-F1-001 frames, but the t=1 sectors 2,3,6,7 (one shared layout) get pair-AND ancillas w01,w23 and ONE merged phase polynomial on f over x=t~l, y=tl, r, w01, w23 (one-hot NOT split by r for t=1: 4 ancillas, 32 CX one-hot round trip); final frame re-factored to start with (1 2) so its CX cancels the last Bell-decoder CX; 172 CX.

F1 datapath (parity frame, 8 Fredkin q2-permutation frames, Bell decode) with a partial sector one-hot: (t,l) lines of the same-frame sector pairs {2,3},{6,7} are not split by p_r; each pair is one Walsh-Gray R_x over (line&w23 or line, p_r, w01) with shared Bell-pair ANDs; beta-free segments re-synthesised (7-CX Fredkins).

F1 layout (parity frame, 8 f-controlled Fredkins DP-ordered over sectors, Bell decode, persistent sector one-hot, Gray-code C^3-R_x middles) with each Fredkin emitted as a 7-CX Clifford+T circuit instead of cx+ccx+cx (8 CX); 192 CX.

parent r02-F1-002 (frames, merged t=1 group phase polynomial, Bell-decoder/Fredkin CX cancellation) with every one of the 8 f-controlled q2 swaps emitted as the 7-CX Clifford+T Fredkin of r02-F3-002 (its dagger form where the first CX is cancelled against the last Bell-decoder CX); 164 CX.

F1 elite datapath (parity frame, 8 Fredkin frames, final frame refactored to start with (1 2), merged 12-term phase polynomial for t=1 sectors 2,3,6,7 over x=t~l,y=tl,r,w01,w23, r-split one-hot only for t=0) recorded and re-emitted with level-3 resynthesis of every beta-free segment between rotations (7-CX Fredkins, decoder/one-hot CX cancellations); 6 ancillas, 165 CX.

r02-F1-002 layout, but a (p_r & ~p_t & ~f)-controlled [Z q2^0 Z q2^1, then Fredkin(q2^0,q2^2)] at start/end maps sectors 1,5 exactly onto 0,4, so r drops out of the t=0 sectors: 6 frame Fredkins (7-CX), no r-split one-hot, 4 middles instead of 6; 151 CX.

one f-controlled frame tour id -> G=(3,0,1,2) -> id (6 Fredkins) for all 8 parity sectors: the first and last (0 2) swap is controlled by c = (p_r&~p_t) xor f&(p_t|p_r^p_l) (= f for t=1), which routes sectors 0,1,4,5 onto the sector-4 normal form at G, so one 3-control middle on ~p_t serves t=0 and the t=1 group polynomial is fitted directly on (p_t, p_r^p_l, p_r, w01, w23) without a one-hot; 116 CX, 12 qubits.

r03-F3-003 r-fold kept, but the t=1 group sits in the 1-swap frame (0 2) using relaxed (spectator-swap) sector forms, the frame walk becomes (0 2) | G | (0 1)(2 3) | S4 | (1 3) | S0 | (0 1)(2 3), the forward fold swap is merged into the first frame swap as one (f OR u)-controlled Fredkin, the fold Paulis become free Z gates, and the one-hot needs only one AND (y = t l): 7 Fredkins in total (6 routing, one of them (f|u)-controlled, + 1 inverse-fold), 12 qubits, 129 CX.

r-fold of sectors 1,5 onto 0,4 with OR-merged first Fredkin, CZ(F,PR)/CZ(F,PL) sign knobs absorbed into the parity CX, t=1 group at the (0 2) frame fitted constant-free (11 terms, walk 14), one-AND selector lines (5 CX).

two commuting branch-controlled swaps per leg, (1 3) on c2 = f&~t and (0 2) on c1 = (~t&~r) xor f xor c2&p_l', put all 8 parity sectors into ONE Bell-diagonal frame (pairs (0,1),(2,3)); a single middle (w01, w23 ANDs, 11-term phase polynomial on (t, r, p_l', w01, w23, u=~t&~r), 14-CX walk) serves t=0 and t=1; 4 Fredkins instead of 6, 98 CX, 11 rotations, 12 qubits.

line-free routing: nine Fredkins whose controls are single q1 wires holding affine functions of (f, p_r, p_t, p_l) (6 parity CX in total, no u/e lines, no rccx toggles), tour (0 2)[f^p_l] (0 3)[f] (0 2)[p_r^p_l] (0 1)[f] | t=0 middle (decoder (1,2), 3-control R_x on ~p_t) | (0 1)[f] (0 2)[p_r^p_l] (0 3)[f] (0 2)[p_l] | t=1 group (pairs (0,1),(2,3), 17-term polynomial on (p_r^p_l, p_t, p_l, w01, w23), Gray walk 18) | (0 2)[f]; 113 CX, 10 qubits.

two-swap frame for all 8 parity sectors at once: swap(q2^1,q2^3) controlled by c2 = ~p_t & ~s_r and swap(q2^0,q2^2) controlled by c1 = f & ~g (g = ~p_t & (p_r^p_l), one persistent AND line) bring every sector to a diagonal form under the single Bell pairing (0,1),(2,3), so ONE R_x phase polynomial on f over (p_r, p_r^p_l, p_t, w01, w23, g) (9 terms, 14-CX walk) replaces both middles; 4 Fredkins instead of 6, 94 CX, 12 qubits.

r05-F1/F3 two-swap single-middle frame ((1 3)[c2], (0 2)[c1], Bell pairs (0,1),(2,3), one 9-term R_x phase polynomial on f, 14-CX walk) with the c2 control line and the persistent g line merged into ONE ancilla chain L: 0 -> c2 = ~p_t&~s_r -> g = ~p_t&(s_r^s_l) (the second rccx adds ~p_t&~s_l), so g costs no compute/uncompute of its own; the two rccx on the c1/w01 ancilla are fused (-2 T each side); 88 CX, 11 qubits.

r05-F3-005 two-swap single-middle datapath with a shared-factor toggle chain on one line G: G = c2 = ~p_t & ~z_r (rccx) controls swap(q2^1,q2^3), then ONE rccx with the raw ~z_l wire turns it into the persistent g = ~p_t & (z_r^z_l) (c2 ^ ~p_t&~z_l = g) used by the c1 = f&~g swap(q2^0,q2^2) and the 9-term middle polynomial; mirrored on the way back; the separate g line and its 2 rccx disappear (-6 CX), and the c1-uncompute/w01-compute rccx pairs on one target are fused (Tdg H H T = I, -4 T); 88 CX, 11 qubits.

g-line-free two-swap frame: the (0 2) control c02 = ~lp & s_t (one rccx) is converted after its Fredkin by U ^= f & ~lp into the invariant line u = p_t & ~lp, which both feeds the (1 3) control ~(s_r & ~u) (one rccx) and serves as the g-class middle variable, so the persistent g line disappears (control cost 24 instead of 30 CX); R_x polynomial (8 terms + constant, 9 rotations) on (r, lp, t, u, w01, w23) with an open walk whose closing r toggle merges into the leg-2 parity CX (13 CX); 87 CX, 11 qubits.
